observed_behavior: A valid planning-review sprint without execution or a tasklet graph aborts plan indexing for missing tasklet headings.
expected_behavior: The index records planning-only sprints without requiring executable tasklets, while detailed graphs and executable sprints retain heading validation.
causal_mechanism: The projection applied the executable heading parser unconditionally and considered STUB status alone, omitting the canonical sibling-graph presence boundary.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A projection reproduces only part of the canonical eligibility predicate.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Records accepted by the owning validator become indexing failures; their sibling inputs are also absent from the parse-cache key.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Projection eligibility and its cache identity account for every input in the canonical execution/graph predicate.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Pass graph presence from the file inventory into the sprint parser and include it in the file's parser identity.

applicability_conditions: Projection depends on both source content and sibling-file presence.
known_non_matches: Executable sprints and detailed empty graphs still require tasklet headings.
confirmation_evidence: The planning-review regression failed before the fix and passes after it.
regression_proofs: tests/project-index.test.js: indexes planning-only sprints while enforcing executable and tasklet-graph headings
